script: James Harden has to be the funniest player of all time. Like this dude never took the game seriously. Watch him not even trying on defense, but he somehow gets the cleanest block of all time. And when he does decide to play defense, it's on his own teammate! Anytime he has a defensive highlight, there's always something extra on top, like why is this guy on the bench, then he gets a steal. Or how about this play where he just lets the other team get the ball for no reason. This one isn't even a play, but who remembers the time he put on a fat suit to get traded. And of course, you can't forget the moment where he spikes the ball in frustration hitting himself, which leaves Josh Hart absolutely confused!
what_makes_it_work: Highlights highly recognizable viral NBA meme moments that drive high engagement and comments.
Fast-paced editing switches clips every few seconds to maintain visual interest.
Concludes with an iconic reaction frame from Josh Hart that provides a comedic payoff.
